game.label: Your own dump of inFAMOUS Second Son for PS4 (CUSA00223, US): the base game 1.00 with update 1.07 copied over it, in one folder with eboot.bin at its top.

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Windowed opens in a window. Borderless fills the screen and lets you switch apps quickly. Fullscreen gives the game the screen to itself.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: Waits for the screen's refresh so the picture doesn't tear. Off can feel more responsive.

settings.label: Show FPS
settings.help: The frame rate in a corner of the game.

settings.label: Stick dead zone
settings.help: How far a stick has to move before the game reacts. Raise it if the camera drifts on its own.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: The game's logs, newest last. Send one when you report a problem.
